profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lyric
profile.summary: Experienced Full Stack Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in modern software technology stacks. Highly skilled with all aspects of designing and building modern web applications from relational database design, performance-driven server-side development, infrastructure management, and user-oriented front-end experiences. Spent several years as lead data engineer using both de-normalized dimensional modeling techniques as well as newer MART data structures to build a health oriented data warehouse. Has experience operationalizing real-time high-performance machine learning systems and incorporating them into existing application stacks. Has a passion for tackling challenging projects and quickly learning the languages, skills, and contextual knowledge required to complete them with excellence.

positions.description: Skills: SQL · Terraform · NestJS · Docker Products · Express.js · XGBoost · PostgreSQL · gRPC · Amazon Redshift · Kubernetes · Angular · Data Build Tool (DBT) · AWS Lambda · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Jinja · Traefik · GitHub · HTML · OpenAPI Specification (OAS) · Python (Programming Language) · Shell Scripting · Tailwind CSS · Amazon Cognito · TypeScript · OAuth · Amazon ECS · AWS SageMaker · Node.js · AWS Step Functions

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
--Front-end design (HTML, CSS, Javascript, React.js).  
--Server-side development (Node.js, MongoDB, Pug Templating Engine, Express.js).  
--Mobile Development (iOS & Android with React-Native). 
--I use Github and Gitlab for repository management (https://github.com/pwbrown).  
--Experience with automated use case testing (Selenium web driver, Mocha, TestCafe). 
--Experience with automated asset minification, streamlined deployment, and CDN usage (Gulp, AWS-SDK).  
--Extended AWS experience using Elastic Beanstalk, Application/Classic Load Balancers, Route53, Lambda (For Alexa Skills Development), EC2 Management, and SSL Certificate Managment.
--Experience with Amazon Echo Alexa-Skills-Kit
--Experience with WebSockets both client and server-side (Chat, and real-time application updating)
--Heavy emphasis on enhanced in-memory and KV database caching, as well as overall application security and penetration testing.
